title: APACHE II: Critical Illness Score and Limitations
subject: Clinical Scoring Systems
preview: APACHE II uses acute physiology, age and chronic health factors to characterize severity in critically ill cohorts.
quickRevision: APACHE II uses acute physiology, age and chronic health factors to characterize severity in critically ill cohorts.
Scores can vary according to the time window and data used.
Performance depends on case mix and calibration, so published outcome estimates are not universally transferable.

sections.title: Essential distinctions
points: APACHE II uses acute physiology, age and chronic health factors to characterize severity in critically ill cohorts.
It is a prognostic and risk-adjustment tool, not a diagnosis or bedside command to begin a particular treatment.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not use APACHE II alone to make individual treatment-limitation decisions.
